review: Pequod Yi Sang is an ID that’s best used in the Mirror Dungeons, although can see some use in content like Story and Railway. His clashes aren’t particularly the best, but from the poise he gains with his Skills 1 and 2, he can build up poise fairly well and then dump it all into his Skill 2, which can roll up to 5 coins for a final skill power of 24. The main downside with this ID is that it can take a fair amount of turns for him to get up to the point where his Skill 2 always crits and you get the most value with it. Otherwise, it’s up to RNG whether or not he deals that much damage. Another thing to note for this ID is that Pequod Yi Sang is REALLY good for Bleed Teams. He inflicts a lot of bleed potency with his passive and allows for great bleed sustain by inflicting +6 Bleed Count on crits with his Skill 3.
